card.line: The Jabbok is a stream east of the Jordan River where Jacob wrestled and was renamed Israel, and which later marked the border of the Ammonites.

moments.title: Jacob crosses the ford
moments.text: In the night Jacob took his wives, servants, and eleven sons across the ford, a shallow place to cross the Jabbok. He sent all his possessions across too.

moments.title: Jacob wrestles and is renamed
moments.text: After the family crossed the Jabbok, Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him until daybreak. Jacob would not let go without a blessing, and the man said his name would now be Israel.

moments.title: Israel takes Sihon's land
moments.text: Israel defeated King Sihon and took his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok. They stopped at the Ammonite border, because that border was strongly defended.

moments.title: Jabbok marks the Ammonite border
moments.text: Moses told how he gave the Reubenites and Gadites land that reached up to the Jabbok River, the border of the Ammonites.

moments.title: Ammonite king claims the land
moments.text: The Ammonite king said Israel had taken his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok. Jephthah replied that the LORD had given Israel that land from the Amorites.
